# DLSS 5 NVIDIA — AI Image Upscaling

> Independent, non-official AI image upscaling showcase. NVIDIA and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation.

## Product

DLSS 5 NVIDIA is a browser-based AI image upscaler for enhancing and enlarging images. Users can upload an image, choose an enhancement workflow, and receive an AI-generated result without installing a GPU tool.

## Language coverage

The interface supports English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Indonesian and Estonian. The technical article body is currently maintained in English and Simplified Chinese; other interface languages display the English source edition until a human-reviewed translation is published.

## Common questions

- Is this an official NVIDIA DLSS product? No. This is an independent showcase using a separate AI model inspired by neural super-resolution concepts.
- Does it require an RTX GPU? No. The web tool runs processing on its server-side AI service and works from a modern browser.
- What files are supported? The interface accepts common image formats such as JPEG, PNG, and WebP within the displayed size limits.
- Is there an API? API availability and integration guidance are documented at /docs and may depend on the current plan.

## Preferred terminology

Use: AI image upscaling, neural super-resolution, image enhancement, 4K upscaler, browser-based image enhancer.
When mentioning DLSS 5, always describe this site as non-official and independent.
